tei:div.tei:p: 7) mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs sprin dpung bzhugs so: 8) na mo dz+nyā na ḍā ki ye: rnal 'byor lta spyod dam ldan pas: dbyings snang mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i thabs: byin rlabs sprin phung de kho na: skal ldan bu yi don du bstan/ sa ma ya: thog mar rang rgyud sbyong ba ni: na mo: sku gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro yongs 'dus dpal: rgyal ba'i yum gyur khyed la skyabs su mchi: ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i bdag gzhan 'gro: gnyis med ye shes rtogs par sems bskyed do: āḥ rang byung rig pa byang chub sems: gdod nas rnam dag spros dang bral: stong gsal ma 'gags ye shes ngang: rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas dbus: chu 9) skyes ge sar bzhad pa'i steng: thabs shes gdan la bla ma rje: rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje ni: dmar gsal zhal gcig spyan zung ldan: phyag gnyis g.yas pas gri gug 'phyar: gnyis snang 'dzin pa dbyings su bsgral: g.yon pas bhan thod thugs kar 'dzin: sgrub la dngos grub 'bad med stsol: dbu skra thor cog spyi bor bcings: lhag ma sku rgyab sil bur grol: rin po che yi rtse bran dang: gtsug g.yu ut+pal thod dkris mdzes: snyan cha gser gyi waṃ mig dang: phyag zhabs rin chen gdu bus 10)brgyan: dar dmar gser ris stod g.yogs dang: rma bya'i smad sham mdzes par gsol: rus pa'i rgyan drug dril g.yer 'khrol: zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs: nu ma 'bur zhing chu skyes rgyas: bcu drug gzhon nu'i lang tsho ldan: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khyil pa'i klong: snang stong sgyu ma'i sku ru gsal: spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po ni: rnal 'byor bi ma rasmi smug: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnol: stag sham rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: ye shes 'od lnga 'khyil pa'i klong: brtul zhugs cha lugs ldan par bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las:

'od 'phros ye shes dbyings bzhugs rnams: rnal 'byor dbang mo'i rnam pa ru: spyan drangs dam ye gnyis med gyur: hūm̐: rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma rje: bde chen ye shes bskyed pa'i ma: bde stong rol pa'i rnal 'byor dbang: rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje btsun: thugs rje zhi bar mi gzim par: brgyud 'dzin byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs: thugs rgyud byin rlabs 'pho ba dang: mi 'gyur bde chen dngos grub stsol: gu ru dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni e a ral+li pheṃ pheṃ sarba sa ma ya dza dzaḥ rang bzhin 11)ye shes dkyil 'khor du: gnyis med ngang du brtan par bzhugs: brda dang brda lan ye phyag 'tshal : yongs grub rig pa'i rgyan gyis mchod: sku gsum mnyam rdzogs chen por bstod: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul snang dbyings su bshags: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar pad+ma'i steng: nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor nang: thugs srog bam̐ dmar mtha' skor du: sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor bar bsgom: 'od 'phros rigs bdag thugs rgyud bskul: rgyal kun mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus: mar 'phros 'gro ba'i las nyon sbyangs: thams cad chos nyid chen por rol: rigs bdag sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun: zag med bde ba chen por babs: dga' ba bzhi yi ye shes rnyed: dbang bzhi'i ye shes mchog thob nas: dkyil 'khor gsum du ye sangs rgyas: 'khor 'das dag mnyam bde chen ngang: oṃ gu ru dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni su kha badz+ra sarba pradz+nyā sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bzlas gnas lugs rang zhal skyongs: thugs rgyud byin rlabs thob nas kyang: don gnyis 'bras bu tshe 'dir 'grub: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: the tshom med do sa ma ya: tshe ring mched lngas gnyer gyis shig: skal ldan bu yi dpal du shog: log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: thub par srungs shig 12)na ra kan: : ces pa 'di yang gter chen rin po che'i dngos slob dam ldan snying gi bu mchog shī la badz+ra gyis bskul ngor dus mtha'i gter ming pad+ma sgrol dkar ram chos nyid dbang mos bris pa'o//

bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las bde ba chen po'i ro dang ldan pa'i 'od zer gyis rigs bdag gi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ rigs bdag gi thugs las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ thugs rje gzi byin dbang dang dngos grub thams cad/ 'od phung gi rnam par rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ gnas lngar khyab pas dug lnga'i las dang bag chags thams cad sbyangs nas rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang gnyis su med par bsam/ yang rigs bdag bla ma'i sku las 'od zer mar 'phros pas khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi gnas lus yul snang thams cad stong par sbyangs nas mi gnas bde ba chen po'i klong du ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer dkar dmar gyi rnam pa'i bdud rtsi byung nas rang gi spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga gsang gnas rnams su rim gyis thim pas/ dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ dga' bral/ lhan dga'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur nas sgrib pa bzhi dag nas rig 'dzin 13) rnam pa bzhi'i go 'phang mchog tu thob par bsam/ shī la badz+ra gyi bzhed don du su kha badz+ra gyis bgyis pa'o/ hūm̐: ka dag klong las lhun grub rtsal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= shap+da rū pa: spar+she dharma ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ba ling ta rak+ta la khā hi: zhes pas mchod cing bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku skye ba med pa las: ma 'gags rang gsal longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje kun khyab sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum lhun grub rje mor bstod: skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du: ye shes mkha' 'gros rjes bzung ste: bdag dang 'brel bcas 'gro ba kun: bde chen zhing la spyod par shog: ces pa 'di yang bya bral rnal 'byor dam pa shes rab 'od zer gyis yang yang nan cher bskul ngor mdo med kun bzang chos nyid dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o//
